Short, thick, charcoal-grey hair and a matching short beard. Calm, deep-set dark-brown eyes. Appears to be in his late forties with a mature, weathered face. Massive, towering, muscular build. Wears a traditional, oversized light-grey robe with a brown sash. Features large, rounded gorilla ears and a broad, flat nose.
